what: Planned skip branch conflates missing script with present but unusable script
scenario_or_breakage: A consumer adds scripts/relevant-checks.sh but forgets chmod +x or the path is a directory; helper emits RELEVANT_CHECKS_SKIPPED=true and exits 0 so validation is silently bypassed
suggested_fix: Distinguish absent from invalid: only skip when the path is absent; fail structurally for present non-file or non-executable with a dedicated FAILURE_REASON and harness coverage

what: Wrapper selects the check script from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR but does not execute it from that repo
scenario_or_breakage: The migrated script preserves git rev-parse from current cwd, so if PWD is another git repo the consumer repo script can validate the wrong tree or fail as not-in-git
suggested_fix: Have the wrapper cd to REPO_ROOT before invoking CHECK_SCRIPT or have scripts/relevant-checks.sh derive REPO_ROOT from its own location and use git -C; add a regression where CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR differs from PWD

what: New Makefile-only harness is not called out for agent-lint reachability handling
scenario_or_breakage: Plan creates scripts/test-relevant-checks.sh and .md, but the existing allowlist only names the current relevant-checks harnesses; make lint can fail on unreferenced files after the rename
suggested_fix: Add exact agent-lint.toml updates to the plan: add scripts/test-relevant-checks.sh and .md, remove deleted hook/test entries, and update the allowlist comment

what: Final grep gate conflicts with historical changelog references
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed grep for .claude/skills/relevant-checks or /relevant-checks will still match older CHANGELOG entries, creating either a false verification failure or pressure to rewrite historical release notes
suggested_fix: Change the verification gate to exclude CHANGELOG.md and separately assert only the new migration note is present in the current release section, or explicitly allow all CHANGELOG matches
